text:
emily: Quick heads-up: PR #789 tweaks the retry backoff in the Ruby SDK to use exponential jitter. It passed on MRI but failing on JRuby CI with sporadic stream reconnect timing. Can someone with JRuby experience weigh in?

prasanna: I can take a look. Are failures deterministic or timing flakiness?

emily: Flaky. Logs show stream reconnects happening earlier on JRuby than MRI, causing duplicate token-refresh attempts and a 401 race in a couple of integration tests.

yuki: JRuby's thread scheduler is different; sleep semantics can yield differently. If retry logic relies on Thread.sleep for jitter it might behave oddly. Can you paste the snippet?

emily: Snippet from PR:```ruby
backoff = base * (2 ** attempts)
jitter = rand * jitter_fraction * backoff
sleep(backoff + jitter)
```

prasanna: That looks fine. On JRuby rand uses native ThreadLocalRandom? Might be fine. The issue could be our token refresher being inlined into the stream loop. If two threads try refresh concurrently they both call refresh_and_store which isn't guarded.

yuki: Suggestion: add a lightweight mutex around refresh_and_store and make the sleep call use Kernel.sleep rather than Thread.sleep to be explicit. Also add a test that runs the streaming loop under JRuby with tight timings to reproduce.

emily: Good plan. I'll update PR: 1) wrap token refresh in a compare-and-swap guard, 2) switch to Kernel.sleep, 3) add JRuby-specific CI job that runs the streaming flake detector.

pr-bot: CI report: ruby-jruby-9.3 job #56 failed: intermittent 401 in streaming-integration spec. See logs: "Received 401 during stream; token refresh concurrently triggered by two threads."

prasanna: I'll prototype an atomic guard using a simple Redis lock in tests to simulate concurrency, but production change should be an in-process Mutex to avoid external deps.

emily: Agreed. I'll add Mutex.wrap around refresh and update PR description explaining parity rationale. Also will add minimal sampleapp note in Quickstart: "If you're on JRuby, prefer runtime >= 9.3 and ensure thread model tested."

yuki: +1. Once patched, run the JRuby job several times to confirm flake reduced.

emily: Thanks all 44d I'll push a follow-up commit and tag you. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/789 (WIP).
